briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 escalate frontier race with multi-agent breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as frontier labs release models with advanced reasoning. Compute constraints and safety gaps remain central. Global regulatory momentum builds amid rising deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. xAI releases Grok-3 showing strong math gains. Anthropic Claude 4 and Google Gemini 3.0 enter testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters in Europe and Asia. Energy demand concerns prompt new nuclear SMR deals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards emerge before state actors weaponize open models at scale?
